title: Insights

body:
Why packing fails expensive POs For sequin eveningwear, receiving teams reject cartons for barcode mismatches, crushed sequin fields, and missing size assortments—even when the garment itself is fine. Platform-ready packing is part of quality, not an afterthought.
Pre-ship checklist Polybags — Clear bags sized to avoid sequin crush; include size sticker facing out. Hangtags / care labels — Fiber content and care symbols matching market rules. Barcodes — SKU-level codes that scan; verify against the buyer’s ASN template. Assortment — Ratio packs documented on packing list and carton marks. Carton strength — Double-wall for dense sequin goods; no over-compression. Needle detection — Pass records available when required by the buyer. Photo pack — Sample carton open/close photos archived with the PO. FBA and 3PL notes If shipping to Amazon FBA or a third-party warehouse, confirm label placement, carton weight limits, and whether sequin fringe styles need tissue or boards. Sparyn can adapt packing to Fashion Nova, SHEIN, Temu, Windsor Store, and private-label intake rules when specs are shared at sampling.
Close the loop Approve packing on the SMS unit—not only the garment. A sealed sample bag with the correct sticker format prevents expensive rework at the destination dock.

body:
The real risk in partywear sourcing Sequin eveningwear has more process steps than basic jersey dresses: pattern, sequin application, lining, stretch recovery, and delicate packing. When a trader sits between you and the line, feedback loops lengthen and bulk drift becomes common—especially on Fashion Nova or SHEIN-speed calendars.
Signals of a production-capable partner Can share in-line photos of cutting, sequin work, and sewing for your style. Owns or tightly controls sample room turnaround (days, not weeks). Speaks clearly about AQL, needle detection, and carton standards. Can explain why a sequin map was changed between SMS and bulk. Offers one project contact accountable for cost, quality, and ship date. Signals you are talking to a pure trader Vague answers on which workshop does sequin application. Samples arrive with different fabric handfeel than the quoted bulk mill. Cannot provide packing photos until goods are already sealed. Price jumps after “factory confirmation” without a clear BOM change. What platform vendors should require Written SMS approval with measurement sheet. Locked BOM including sequin lot and lining. Mid-production photo or video update. Pre-shipment AQL report and carton count. Reorder archive so season two matches season one. Sparyn operates as a manufacturing partner with dedicated sequin RTW lines in Guangdong—built for buyers who need predictable bulk, not just a low first quote.

body:
Why sequin choice matters For evening dresses sold on Fashion Nova, SHEIN, Temu, or Windsor Store-style storefronts, sequin selection is not only aesthetic—it drives returns, photo QC pass rates, and chargeback risk. The wrong sequin size or attachment method looks stunning in studio lighting and fails after one wear or one carton transit.
Flat sequins (3–5 mm) Flat sequins remain the volume workhorse for bodycon minis and midi dresses. They lay close to the fabric, photograph evenly, and pack denser in cartons. Specify density maps on the tech pack: sparse fields look cheap; over-dense fields crack when stretched. Ask your factory for a stretch swatch before bulk.
Holographic and iridescent Holographic sequins convert well in video and carousel images. They also reveal shade variation under different warehouse LED lighting. Approve SMS under both daylight and warm retail lighting, and lock a master shade card for reorders.
Velvet and matte sequins Velvet sequin fields deliver premium handfeel for colder-season drops. They shed differently than flat PVC sequins—request a rub test and confirm lining coverage so skin contact stays comfortable for try-on content creators.
Fringe and tassel sequin Fringe drives social video but creates packing challenges. Specify how fringe is folded in polybags and whether carton compression is allowed. Many platform returns originate from tangled fringe rather than fit issues.
Attachment methods Sewn vs glued vs heat-applied sequin films behave differently in wash and stretch tests. For stretch bodycon, prefer sewn or film systems validated on the exact base fabric. Document the method on the BOM so season-two reorders do not silently switch.
Buyer checklist Approve a physical SMS, not only digital renders. Lock sequin size, color lot, density map, and attachment method. Run a five-wear stretch and rub test before PO. Confirm lining and care label language for US/EU markets. Archive photos of the approved SMS for AQL comparison. Sparyn develops sequin maps as part of every eveningwear program and archives approved specs for reorder consistency.
